paragraphs.text: Pontotoc’s boys will play Grissom of Huntsville, Alabama, at 11:30 a.m. Friday, Nov. 27, in Corinth. The Warriors have the second game of the Lighthouse Classic at Corinth High School. Alcorn Central and Holly Springs open the day at 10 a.m.

The Warriors head into Thursday’s trip to Tupelo coming off a 68–34 home win over Louisville on Tuesday. It was the most Pontotoc had scored in its first three games. The Warriors opened with a 55–44 win over Lake Cormorant and lost 63–44 to DeSoto Central.
Grissom also won by more than 30 points in its most recent game, beating St. John Paul II 71–36 on Monday. The Tigers list Sparkman, LeFlore and North Little Rock before their meeting with Pontotoc.

For fans traveling to Corinth, the gym is at 1310 N. Harper Road. The organizer lists admission at $20 for adults and $10 for students in kindergarten through 12th grade, with children 5 and younger admitted free. A one-day pass that allows fans to leave and return costs $25.
